svg.title: The four cost-matched SwarmBench tasks
svg.desc: At matched cost ceilings, swarm scores exceed single-agent scores for multi-text understanding, long-text generation, and wide search. Single-agent root-cause analysis scores are higher. Only four of the eight benchmark tasks have this comparison. Haiku 4.5 single agent and orchestrator; heterogeneous workers; 50 examples per task. Single-agent spending is capped at each task's mean swarm cost. Different metrics and axis ranges; no combined accuracy. No comparison intervals are supplied.
svg.metadata: https://arxiv.org/html/2608.30661v1 | Table 7, Appendix D.1; metrics in Appendix C.1; v1, 31 August 2026
